epistemics: Lifts are odds ratios on the proposal split (3.6-3.8), confirmed on the confirmation split; absence is informative only above the signal floor (3.5); `no gain` means found but already carried by the trivial alternation model (3.11); loop-rule verdicts are recorded, not promoted (3.16); cells are bit-horizons net of the larger of two controls, with share of the receiver's ceiling where a diagonal exists (3.12).

keyed_pairs_not_found.note: baroreflex: a rise in arterial pressure slows the heart within 1-2 beats
respiratory sinus arrhythmia: inspiration speeds the heart
apnea -> desaturation, tens of seconds later (records with SO2 only)

absences.note: absence is informative only for pairs whose support would exceed the signal floor
